top_violation_types.title: Alternate Activity for Non-sleeping Children (26 TAC §746.2907(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Awaken children were not given an alternative activity during naptime.

top_violation_types.title: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date (26 TAC §746.3805(b)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Medication was not kept or stored in the original container for a child in care.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File (26 TAC §746.2428)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An infant was observed swaddled in a blanket while being held by a caregiver.

top_violation_types.title: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep (26 TAC §746.2905(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: This standard was found to be deficient. A caregiver admitted to placing the blanket on the child's head and can be seen doing so in a video.

top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The proper depth of loose fill is not being maintained on the playground.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete.
